title: Agnee Prem
desc: The film is a love story between a rich girl and middle class boy. The girls stepmother is against the alliance so they run away. they are helped by a lawyer. The girls father sends a hired killer to finish he boy but the killer is under the impression that the boy is characterless. He finds out the truth in time and then helps the lovers.

title: Zakhm
desc: The story revolves around a young boy, Ajay, who grows up torn between his mother's Muslim identity and his father's Hindu beliefs. When his mother is killed in a communal riot, Ajay is forced to confront his past and reconcile his conflicted identity. The film explores themes of love, loss, and communal harmony against the backdrop of religious tensions in India.

title: Ittefaq
desc: Dilip Roy is a painter by trade and, despite possessing a beautiful wife called Sushma, he spends most of his time painting. On the day of their anniversary celebration, Dilip is late finishing a painting when a frustrated Sushma snatches the brush from his hand. Furious, Dilip strangles her to death, is arrested and sent to a psychiatric institute.

title: Khoon Ka Karz
desc: Two young friends are raised in the same orphanage by an affectionate warden. Although they promise her not to stray, fate makes them the biggest gangsters in town. Will she be able to save them now?
